theorems.name: Submission.gwe_vgt_weight_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∃ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ g y) ∧ g =ᵐ[(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))] V.carrier.indicator V.mult) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Amb n ℓ), MeasurableSet S → ∀ φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in S, φ y ∂V.weight = ∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (V.carrier.indicator V.mult y) * φ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
